items.title: Modernize earned premium using InsuranceLake and Coherent Spark on AWS
items.summary: In this post you will explore how finance and actuarial teams can find a balance between the ability to scale models and to experiment with changes. AWS InsuranceLake accelerator solution will be used ingest commercial auto and workers compensation policy data containing written premiums and enrich it with calculated earned monthly premiums using an Excel spreadsheet-based model that has been turned into an API and made enterprise grade with Coherent Spark on AWS.
items.creator: Cory Visi
